rationale: The short thesis has failed to materialize, with price stalling at the entry level ($10.24) and consolidating directly on the 9-EMA and VWAP for over 3.5 hours, indicating a lack of the expected downward momentum. With the invalidation level ($10.28) only 4 cents away and the take-profit ($10.18) 6 cents away, the risk-reward profile is unfavorable, and the flat price action suggests the initial supply pressure has been absorbed.
